data.summary:
Competent and seasoned professional with 13+ years of experience in working closely with operations, client on boarding, strategy frameworks, mutualization, global operating model, project management, transform initiatives, asset and wealth management communicating specific client requests, and aligning client requests with internal policies and requirements
Demonstrable experience in providing advice and interpretation on the application of KYC/AML and sanctions requirements in response to and in support of business line, engaging key partners and senior management ∙ Proficiency in conducting enhanced due diligence (EDD) as well as ongoing monitoring for customers deemed high risk
Hands-on experience in driving support and growth of process and decision low code automation capability and center of excellence across all aspects, driving product strategy, methodology, developing and implementing governance and quality control standards
Conversant in orchestrating complete client on boarding process, including oversight of functions involved in on boarding process and understanding clients and business’s needs
Proven track record in working closely with project teams in providing support with the requirements and scope from design to implementation

raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Associate- AVP | JP Morgan Chase & Co – Asset and Wealth Management Jun 2024 – May 2026
Key Deliverables
Driving a team in the asset and wealth management that includes client on boarding, KYC, review management
and transformation.
Expertise in AML/KYC onboarding, review maker/checker
Leading Customer Lifecycle Management (CLM) initiatives covering Client Onboarding, KYC remediation, periodic reviews, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), and regulatory compliance requirements.
Partnering with senior business stakeholders, compliance, risk and operations teams to drive onboarding transformation and governance initiatives.
Preparing executive-level status reports, governance updates and program dashboards for leadership review.
People management and guiding them through appropriate directions to be aligned with the organizational goals.
Collaborated with business partners on organizational change and the impact assessment of such change on risk control frameworks, people, technology and processes.
Supported in mobilizing best practices and transformations initiatives utilizing the operating model design framework
Co-ordinate with Process Owners to plan process continuous improvement efforts and identify best practices
Project Manager | Societe Generale Global Solution Center Pvt Ltd Jan 2022 – Jun 2024
Key Deliverables
Driving a cross-functional team for KYC, review management, reopen of clients’ transformation ∙ Collaborating with project management on transformation initiatives aiming at automation and efficiency gains
Driving a cross-functional team for finance, p2p, accounting and reporting, regulatory reporting, - working on mode frameworks on transformational initiatives aiming at automations, efficiency gains and risk management
Analyzing production trends, bottlenecks, process step issues, and suggestions for changes/enhancements to the E2E (end-to-end) processes
Managed end-to-end program governance including risk management, issue tracking, milestone reporting and stakeholder communications across KYC and onboarding transformation programs.
Supported regulatory change initiatives and Customer Lifecycle Management (CLM) programs focused on onboarding optimization, process standardization and operational efficiency.
Facilitated steering committee discussions and prepared executive presentations supporting transformation investment decisions.
Collaborated with business partners on organizational change and the impact assessment of such change on risk control frameworks, people, technology and processes.
Supported in mobilizing best practices and transformations initiatives utilizing the operating model design framework
Contributed to mutualization of projects including assessment or current state process, documentation of key pain points, and development of recommendations in the global operating models.
Co-ordinated with Process Owners to plan process continuous improvement efforts and identify best practices
Team Lead and Quality Controller | Societe Generale Global Solution Center Pvt Ltd Dec 2013 – Jan  2022
Key Deliverables
Directed a team of 7 Process Associates and Senior Process Associates for migration of on boarding sub processes from onshore to offshore
Conceptualized and led high-impact initiatives while exploiting technologies to drive client acquisition and deepen on boarding engagement
Drove a cross-functional team in Bangalore and Chennai; training and mentoring new joiners Key Highlights
Led successful migration of sub-processes from onshore to offshore for the connected party/technical counterparty on boarding
Delivered inputs on automating data collection from external applications that achieved savings of 3-4FTEs in budget and saved processing time for funds onboarding
Secured approval from management for automating a part of the onboarding process using triggers, BOT, and machine learning to source documents and special onboard funds (ongoing), which would attain 1.5 FTE savings through smart on boarding
Trained deaf and mute candidates to production and achieved 98% quality metrics; awarded with the best trainer for v-Shesh candidates
Contributed and delivered migration of campaign ledger from excel to the application online ∙ Transformed the manual activity of identifying/assigning teams for KYC review management to the Macro based tool
Administered CSR by actively participating in donations/cultural programs/curriculum for the government school kids
Associate Analyst – Legal Entity – UBS Process | Wipro BPO July 2012 – Nov  2013
Key Deliverables
Operated as a part of a pilot batch for legal entity Masters Process for UBS
Created clients in legal entity masters for various clients, including corporates, banks, financial institutes, and consolidated static reference data under one view via trusted sources/vendors
Demonstrated and examined standard operating procedures (SOPs) to provide clear guidelines for staff and authorized initiatives wherever circumstances dictate
Completed UAT testing for every release to facilitate change management pertinent to process and applications; shared feedback to improvise the process
Key Highlights
Attained SLAs and KPIs in terms of quality/productivity/escalations; documented SLAs and analysis on delivery such as Turnaround Time, customer satisfaction, etc., as agreed with the client
Successfully communicated with all internal departments on a day-to-day basis for inter-departmental coordination to run the workflow
